name: Cultist: Rapid Hunger makes Devour Magic instant cast natively (#1790)
contract: 301010 is ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108), MiscValue=10 (SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME), EffectBasePoints=-101/DieSides=1 giving a flat -100% (SpellInfo.cpp:489), classmask dword0=8388608 (bit23). Verified against Spell.dbc: 520151 'Devour Magic' has SpellFamilyFlags dword0=8388608 (bit23 set) and CastingTimeIndex=4 (base 1000 ms); 520151 is also the spell the Cultist's class-spell table actually grants at level 26 (AscensionCustomClassData.h:553), not the sibling ID 520152 (whose SpellFamilyFlags are all zero and does not match). Player::ApplySpellMod (Player.cpp:10315) applies SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME as (base + flat) * totalmul, so a -100% multiplier collapses any positive base to 0 -- instant cast, matching the tooltip exactly. No script needed.
